title: Cross-Desk Reference — The Coverage Allowance on a Returned Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Cross-Desk Reference — The Coverage Allowance on a Returned Payment, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where the customer whose payment the bank sent back unpaid on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan also holds care coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, the finance desk grants a coverage allowance against the charge. The desk reads the coverage record — the standing it carries and the premium arrangement of the coverage — and the premiums taken under that coverage.

| The customer's care coverage | The coverage allowance |
|---|---|
| Stands in force, its premium is collected month by month, and a premium has been taken under it in the three whole calendar months ending on the handling date | **8.00 USD** |
| Stands in force and its premium is collected in one payment | **4.00 USD** |
| Any other case, including a customer holding no care coverage | No coverage allowance is granted |

The first row needs all three of its conditions: coverage in force whose premium is collected month by month, but with no premium taken in the three whole calendar months ending on the handling date, does not reach it, and — its premium not being collected in one payment — does not reach the second row either, so no coverage allowance is granted.

## What is read from the coverage record

The standing of the coverage and whether its premium is collected month by month or in one payment come from the customer's coverage record under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans and the arrangement its coverage runs on; the premiums taken are the premium entries recorded under that coverage.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- Coverage in force, premium collected month by month, a premium taken last month: 8.00 USD.
- Coverage in force, premium collected in one payment at the outset: 4.00 USD.
- Coverage in force, premium collected month by month, but the last premium was taken five months ago: no coverage allowance.
- Coverage that has lapsed or been cancelled: no coverage allowance.
